name: Stable Labeled Sample Compression of Full Cube
proof: The database-owned proper stable labeled full-cube value proof gives an explicit stable scheme of width $\lceil n/2\rceil$, so the same upper bound holds without imposing properness. The stable-compression theorem gives the lower bound by projected NCTD, which is $\lceil n/2\rceil$ on the full cube. Thus equality holds. The former assertion that labeled compression dominates VC without a constant was invalid; that exact lower bound applies to the unlabeled model.
references: The explicit block certificate in the proper stable labeled full-cube value proof; survey theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star and \cite{KSZ2019}.
